Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 2, Verse 31

“Considering your own duty as well, you should not waver. For a kshatriya there exists nothing better than a righteous war.”

Krishna switches register from metaphysics to social duty, meeting Arjuna where he actually lives. Note dharmya — the war is defensible because it is righteous, not because fighting is a warrior's habit.
